name: Menu bar, dialogs and shortcuts
body:
# Menu bar, dialogs and shortcuts

A real application shell around the viewport: a menu bar (File, Edit, View, Entity, Help) with the shortcut shown
beside each item, native open and save dialogs, a recent-files list, an unsaved-changes prompt, and keyboard
shortcuts that work anywhere in the window rather than only while the pointer is over the viewport.

Depends on penumbra-ui-backend's file dialogs (`GAME-F02-T09`) and Penumbra's key events (`GAME-F02-T06`).
